run_generate_cli: run the generate.py CLI to print curriculum math questions to stdout with configurable filters
init_modules_train_split: init modules with train-easy, train-medium, train-hard difficulty splits for math problem generation
sample_from_module: sample a math problem from a module, dropping questions or answers that exceed max length settings
filter_and_flatten_modules: filter and flatten nested module dicts by name prefix into a sorted ordered dict
make_entropy_fn: create an entropy subrange function that maps difficulty levels to fractional entropy intervals
